description: This file defines an Angular component named 'Row' which renders a flexible row layout with customizable alignment and distribution properties. It extends a DynamicComponent and uses Angular's component decorator, inputs, and template syntax to generate a stylized flex container.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: An Angular component for rendering a flexible row layout with customizable alignment and distribution.

methods.name: alignment
methods.description: Input property to set the alignment of items within the row, defaults to 'stretch'.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Input property to set the distribution of items within the row, defaults to 'start'.

methods.name: classes
methods.description: A computed property that generates CSS classes based on theme and layout properties.
